entities.summary: Kadim Jabbar Al Samarai, better known by his stage name Kadim Al Sahir, is an Iraqi singer and composer. Dubbed The Caesar, he has earned numerous local, regional, and international awards. One of the most famous singers in the Arab world, Al-Sahir has sold more than 100 million albums and written more than 40 hit songs, including "Ana Wa Layla", "Salamtak Men Al Ah" and "La Titnahad".
